final_research_resolution: Apply calendar-correct CPI evidence and corrected null comparisons in research; retain the documented zero verdict changes under the original scoring rules.

final_research_resolution: Specify exact calendar alignment in the historical helper scripts; distinguish benign pre-gap results from affected modern CPI calculations.

final_research_resolution: Retire the old composite score and its four kill criteria as the final decision authority. Specify indicator-level observations, comparisons and review actions; do not patch the old composite into a new trading rule.

final_research_resolution: Record the V6 builder/output mismatch and require reproducible evidence-to-verdict provenance in any later tool.

final_research_resolution: Require equal prominence for sample size, uncertainty, false alarms, event definition and dependence in any future display.

final_research_resolution: Require independent pinned values and comparator/prose consistency checks, while acknowledging existing core/calendar and shared-helper coverage.
reason: The blanket claim of no core coverage and no failing test under a shared-helper regression is too broad; precise remaining coverage gaps survive.

final_research_resolution: Apply declustering across versions that preserve the same economic definition; keep materially changed definitions in separate, nonpooled records with an explicit transition policy.
reason: Version-only cooldown reset is a defect, but indiscriminately pooling different definitions is also invalid.

final_research_resolution: Specify tier-aware source failures, explicit unavailable indicators and retained valid observations, with no silent fallback.

final_research_resolution: Preserve immutable successful data and failed-attempt records. A clearly labeled failure/degraded page may intentionally replace the normal page; never present stale successful data as newly healthy.
reason: The prior failure-HTML behavior was documented as intentional. Page replacement is not inherently a durability defect; distinguish data preservation from interface policy.

final_research_resolution: Record that the historical total-return docstring promises an extension the function does not implement.
reason: Documentation must describe actual behavior; the preserved source remains unchanged.

final_research_resolution: Retire 82.14% as a corpus truth probability. Show the 2553-row ledger,1430 fact-verdict rows and 1058-row eligible headline denominator explicitly.
reason: The percentage summarizes selected labels and excludes large classes of propositions.

final_research_resolution: Replace 'never examined' with the documented unresolved-claim taxonomy, distinguishing public evidence gaps, commercial evidence and insufficient operational definitions.
reason: Unverifiable is neither unexamined nor false.

final_research_resolution: Withdraw a definitive channel ranking while reporting the observed conditional direction and the incomplete-bootstrap and selection limitations.
reason: The successful 862 of 1500 bootstrap draws are not an unqualified full-bootstrap interval; missing public and paid material prevents a channel-wide ranking.

final_research_resolution: Withdraw the five specified CPI-dependent rebuttals as reliable corrections of the speakers.
reason: The study's own calendar error supplied several asserted discrepancies; this does not automatically validate every surrounding proposition.

final_research_resolution: Withdraw the positive core-acceleration reading; retain the positive headline-minus-core gap as descriptive supply-shock evidence.
reason: The corrected core acceleration changes sign while the gap remains above the declared threshold; neither statistic alone identifies causation.

final_research_resolution: Withdraw the accusation that headline CPI never printed 2.4% in early 2026.
reason: January 2.391% and February 2.434% both round to 2.4%; core CPI is a separate series.

final_research_resolution: Correct the supporting historical month: August 2024 is 2.607%; September 2024 is 2.426%.
reason: The original detail contains an independent one-month error.

final_research_resolution: Retire 98.6% as a matched rival-forecaster result. Report the row-object always-up calculation with mapped-series coverage and denominator limits.
reason: A valid benchmark must match object, window, scoring rule and availability; unmapped series cannot silently become valid benchmark observations.

final_research_resolution: Replace the unsupported original expanding-rank robustness claim with the archived reproduced check; do not say Review 003 was the first study to examine expanding ranks.
reason: Absence of an original implementation supports 'not substantiated by archived code', not certainty about every unrecorded action; Review 002 already computed expanding variants.

final_research_resolution: Withdraw 'nothing else, ever'; show 11 full-sample versus 35 expanding-rank months in the reproduced relaxed screen.
reason: The uniqueness claim fails under the alternate ranking convention; do not assert this is the only possible conclusion affected elsewhere.

final_research_resolution: Replace the difference-of-medians claim with paired statistics, keeping the 253 overlapping PPI starts separate from 13 analog episodes. Report annualized attenuation without inferring a tactical investment rule.
reason: A lower annualized excess does not show that a cumulative edge disappears or establish 'a trade, not an allocation'.

final_research_resolution: Withdraw the 14%-versus 42% rebuttal. The Chicago Fed paper verifies$849 bn as 14% of insurer balance sheets; it does not identify 42% as a share of a consistently defined private-credit market.
reason: The primary denominator can now be checked; source absence is no longer the reason to leave the market-share comparison unresolved.

final_research_resolution: Withdraw the 0 of 7 base-rate invocation for the current episode unless the bill series and qualifying rule match.
reason: Monthly TB3MS and daily DGS3MO yield different current classifications; the difference must not be hidden by a generic policy label.

final_research_resolution: Label original full-sample base rates as diagnostic and carry completed expanding component analyses plus the new joint-pool completion explicitly.
reason: Do not present already completed energy/calm-credit checks as wholly unperformed; remaining uncertainty concerns specification and small dependent samples.

final_research_resolution: Do not recommend an energy tilt from these studies. Compare benchmarks within the same sample: mature analog n=12 has +9.4468 pp MKT versus +2.4102 pp EW12; PPI n=253 has +10.7019 pp versus +6.5936 pp.
reason: The source proposal's +10.70-to-+2.41 comparison changes sample and benchmark simultaneously. Selected historical medians do not establish an implementable allocation advantage.

final_research_resolution: Require precise phrases such as rising policy rates, narrow credit spreads and restrictive financial conditions. Do not ban the word tightening when its measured meaning is explicit.
reason: The defect is ambiguity between price spread and financing restrictiveness, not the vocabulary itself.

final_research_resolution: Carry the six concrete evidence-path corrections. Separate video-date factual verification from forecast-outcome scoring over its declared later horizon.
reason: The proposed blanket ban on post-video outcomes would make prediction scoring impossible; later evidence may also document a fact's historical state if vintage is disclosed.

final_research_resolution: Describe hash integrity separately from unverified preregistration chronology.
reason: A matching end-of-run hash does not establish when conclusions were first seen and cannot by itself prove that no edit-and-revert ever occurred.

final_research_resolution: Publish diagnostic recession-present-or-onset and strictly future onset records side by side for applicable indicators.
reason: Event assignment was not fixed in the prior preregistration; denominators and zero-eligible samples must remain visible.

final_research_resolution: Demote credit widening from review trigger to watch while retaining its archive and both event definitions.
reason: The 2 of 2 record is coincident diagnostic evidence on two episodes; the strictly future onset sample is n=0 and its rate undefined.

final_research_resolution: Remove the unsupported selection-process assurance; disclose rankings and the absence of a contemporaneous selection record without inferring optimization.
reason: Observed top rankings do not identify the process that produced them; less favorable alternate-target results were also published.

final_research_resolution: Carry the 54-combination 162-row comparison grid and per-indicator exposure alongside selected historical results.
reason: Many small samples and zero observed false alarms create selection risk; a zero observed rate is not proven reliability.

final_research_resolution: Use pseudo-out-of-sample with revised vintages at the point of every historical holdout comparison.
reason: The review already disclosed revised-data limitations broadly; the remaining correction is consistent local labeling.

final_research_resolution: Use annual source/method review and a 24-month usefulness review; accumulate mature alarms honestly without automatic promotion or retirement based on a tiny sample.
reason: Twenty alarms are impractical on a human horizon, while five alarms or ten elapsed years do not create statistical validation.

final_research_resolution: The 26/72 flag is a whole-video-date/keyword exposure heuristic. Lower tagged-row agreement is descriptive; it does not prove that exposure deflated agreement or was immaterial.
reason: All readers could encounter global instructions and no randomized unexposed control exists.

final_research_resolution: Preserve the 35 UNSCORABLE/15 PENDING/8 CANNOT_VERIFY/2 MISSlock and five disclosed primary-source amendments. Two final HITs repeat explicit scaffold verdicts; the Warsh hold shares chronology. Do not attribute the fact reader's notes to the prediction reader.
reason: Shared provenance limits independence; it neither proves copying nor makes official outcome verification invalid.

final_research_resolution: A prediction that recession will be absent throughout September remains OPEN/PENDING as of September 20; the endpoint is September 30 and official recession dating may lag.
reason: An interim observation does not close an unexpired absence claim, unlike a by-deadline event that has already occurred.

final_research_resolution: The 50.2978 CAPE sensitivity rewrites 38 past proxy-earnings months. It is not a forward shock result; Review 002's related 49.6591 September scenario is reproduced.
reason: A future earnings path and a historical measurement counterfactual answer different questions.

final_research_resolution: October 2007 is eligible in the common 684-month window and ranks first under the original expanding screen. Differing eligibility cannot explain all selection differences.
reason: The final controlled comparison holds the candidate calendar fixed.

final_research_resolution: Review 002 already examined expanding PPI-energy and calm-credit components. Final research completes the joint CAPE-rank>=90 and Baa-minus-Aaa-rank<=20 pool separately.

final_research_resolution: The primary paper reports$849 bn of private credit on 2024 life-insurer balance sheets as 14% of those balance sheets. It does not verify 14% or 42% as the share of a common private-credit market universe.
reason: The original rebuttal used an incompatible denominator; a ratio to a separate market estimate needs matching coverage and dates.

final_research_resolution: The observed archive comprises six snapshot and two live records; it is not eight snapshots. No completed prospective alarm outcome is thereby established.
reason: Record type, open observation month, crossing eligibility and mature horizon are separate gates.

final_research_resolution: Specify remaining independent pins and boundary/prose checks without claiming every core/calendar path is untested or a shared-helper regression leaves all 35 tests passing.
reason: The shared headline helper test already detects the generic positional regression; exact coverage matters.

final_research_resolution: Assess factual assertions using the information available at their stated date; evaluate forecasts against later observations within the declared outcome horizon. Preserve source-publication and revision dates in either case.
reason: The literal WD-17 ban on all post-video observations would forbid legitimate forecast scoring.

final_research_resolution: Use the term only with an explicit measured concept, such as rising policy rates or more restrictive financing conditions.
reason: Precise definitions solve the ambiguity; prohibiting a useful economic word does not.

final_research_resolution: Lower annualized paired excess at longer horizons does not establish 'a trade, not an allocation'. No executable timing rule or cost model was validated.
reason: Correct cumulative and annualized statistics can coexist without implying a profitable trading horizon.

final_research_resolution: Use documented conditional endings and mechanism examples as qualitative evidence. Do not imply a coded prevalence rate, complete-channel coverage, no value or no skill. The captured material can generate research questions; incremental investment performance is unestablished.
reason: The 58 public transcripts omit 50 catalogued public entries and 35 paid Jikh entries; semantic counterexamples can refute a universal crash characterization without estimating frequency.

final_research_resolution: 39 exact label disagreements are not 39 proven errors; nine of 13 supported-to-adverse differences mainly involve severity. Sound original calculations can remain preferable when a blind reader lacks the same source or benchmark.
reason: No fixed subtraction from 82.14% or replacement truth probability is justified.

final_research_resolution: Endpoint Yo Y requires t and t-12; declared 12-month acceleration additionally requires t-24. Path/onset/outcome statistics require their specified full path. An unrelated missing interior month is a warning rather than automatic invalidation of every endpoint metric.
reason: A stricter-sounding global completeness rule can incorrectly discard valid observations.

final_research_resolution: The final report, ledger and proposed contract supersede earlier interpretations. Historical sources, sealed judgments and existing monitor code remain unchanged; software requirements await the user's tool decision.
reason: A written specification is not evidence that an implementation has been repaired or tested.

final_research_resolution: An explicitly labeled failed/degraded page may replace the normal dashboard to expose an error. Preserve the last-valid artifact and its date; do not call page replacement itself proof of lost data or silently show stale values as current.
reason: The original failure-display policy was intentional; safe presentation and durable data are separate requirements.

final_research_resolution: Hold the sample fixed in benchmark comparisons. Mature analog episodes (n=12) give +9.4468 pp against MKT and +2.4102 pp against EW12. PPI starts (n=253) give +10.7019 pp and +6.5936 pp respectively.
reason: The proposed +10.70-to-+2.41 fall conflates a sample change with a benchmark change; both correctly paired sensitivities still weaken a universal energy-tilt claim.
